  `alloc::render_does_not_allocate` was fixed and runs again (the sound's physics threads now all start before the
  engine's first step returns; `docs/notes/sound.md`, "No memory taken while a block plays").

  engine's first step returns; `docs/notes/sound.md`, "No memory taken while a block plays").
